title: Fact-check and claim-verification gate
description: Decomposes claims, checks sources, validates citation support, and assigns confidence.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: fact-check-claim-verification
  title: Fact-check and claim-verification gate
  description: Decomposes claims, checks sources, validates citation support, and assigns confidence.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Release only claims with traceable and adequately supported evidence.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 4
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - editor-approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Claims and source corpus
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - claims
          - sources
        x-ladder-input-mode: mixed
    - id: lookup
      kind: agent
      name: Source lookup
      role: Fact checker
      prompt: For each claim, find authoritative supporting or contradicting source passages and record citations.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evidence-verification
          - research
        tools:
          - read
          - search
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: match
      kind: agent
      name: Citation match review
      role: Citation verifier
      prompt: Verify that each cited passage actually supports the claim's scope, qualifiers, dates, and numbers.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-only
      inlineRole: true
    - id: confidence
      kind: evaluate
      inlineRole: true
      name: Confidence gate
      role: Evidence evaluator
      prompt: Return passed only when claims meet the required support and confidence threshold.
      config:
        threshold: 0.85
    - id: editor-approval
      kind: approval
      name: Editor approves exceptions and final claims
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Claim verification ledger
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: lookup
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: lookup
      to: match
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: match
      to: confidence
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: confidence
      to: result
      kind: control
      condition: passed
    - id: e5
      from: confidence
      to: editor-approval
      kind: control
      condition: failed
    - id: e6
      from: editor-approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
